premises: Adding ~50 at.% Pt to FeCoNi-based HEA thin films promotes L1₀ chemical ordering after RTA
L1₀ ordering reduces crystal symmetry and enhances magnetocrystalline anisotropy
Pt provides strong spin-orbit coupling that contributes to high magnetic anisotropy
Enhanced magnetocrystalline anisotropy leads to a large increase in coercivity (orders of magnitude)
The approach is demonstrated in sputtered thin films on oxidized Si substrates with RTA
